_about: Play mats of "You got me Lobster?" (locked: unlocked by a MIX of rare pulls from packs, buying at the card machine and win milestones; every name, odd and price here is a placeholder to edit). Each mat: name, picture assets/tcg/mats/<id>.jpg (made by tools/paint_mats.py), how it comes: "start" (everyone owns it), "pack" (a rare pull: each opened pack has a 1 in pack_one_in chance to bring one pack mat the player does not own yet), "buy" (price in chips at the card machine) or "wins" (that many wins against players: the achievements Ten Up / Table Boss / Lion of the Sand, build step 13b). The table shows each player's own mat on their half.
